mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS registerId, r.case_number AS caseNumber, r.real_name AS realName, r.gender AS gender, r.age AS age, r.card_number AS cardNumber, dep.dept_name AS deptName, lv.regist_name AS registLevelName, DATE_FORMAT(r.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS visitDate, r.noon AS noon, r.visit_state AS visitState, r.regist_money AS registMoney, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(f2.fee_amount) FROM fee_record f2 WHERE f2.register_id = r.id AND f2.fee_type = '收费'), 0) AS chargeAmount FROM register r LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.id LEFT JOIN regist_level lv ON r.regist_level_id = lv.id WHERE r.id = #{registerId}

SELECT d.disease_name FROM medical_record_disease mrd JOIN disease d ON mrd.disease_id = d.id WHERE mrd.medical_record_id = ( SELECT id FROM medical_record WHERE register_id = #{registerId} ) ORDER BY d.id

SELECT '检查' AS itemType, mt.tech_name AS techName, cr.check_state AS state, DATE_FORMAT(cr.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS creationTime, cr.check_result AS result FROM check_request cr LEFT JOIN medical_technology mt ON cr.medical_technology_id = mt.id WHERE cr.register_id = #{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT '检验' AS itemType, mt.tech_name AS techName, ir.inspection_state AS state, DATE_FORMAT(ir.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS creationTime, ir.inspection_result AS result FROM inspection_request ir LEFT JOIN medical_technology mt ON ir.medical_technology_id = mt.id WHERE ir.register_id = #{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT '处置' AS itemType, mt.tech_name AS techName, dr.disposal_state AS state, DATE_FORMAT(dr.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS creationTime, dr.disposal_result AS result FROM disposal_request dr LEFT JOIN medical_technology mt ON dr.medical_technology_id = mt.id WHERE dr.register_id = #{registerId}

SELECT d.drug_name AS drugName, d.drug_format AS drugFormat, p.drug_usage AS drugUsage, p.drug_number AS drugNumber, d.drug_price AS drugPrice, p.drug_state AS state, DATE_FORMAT(p.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS creationTime FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON p.drug_id = d.id WHERE p.register_id = #{registerId} ORDER BY p.id
